question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

Their dog __chewed in__ the furniture.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect preposition "**in**" used after the verb "**chewed**."
 
• The correct preposition to use with **"chewed"** is "**on**" to indicate the object being chewed.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**chewed on the furniture**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Their dog **chewed on **the furniture."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "No improvement"** – This option is incorrect because the original sentence contains an error.
 
• **Option 2: "chewing on"** – This option is incorrect because it changes the tense of the verb.
 
• **Option 3: "chew on"** – This option is incorrect because it changes the tense of the verb.
 
• **Option 4: "chewed on"** – This is the correct option as it uses the correct preposition and retains the correct tense.
